thresholdChecks.title: Model Methodology Appropriate and Justified
thresholdChecks.detail: SS1/23 P3.1 — methodology must be conceptually sound and appropriate for intended purpose

thresholdChecks.title: Feature Engineering Statistically Justified
thresholdChecks.observed: No IV/WoE or feature selection justification in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: All retained features have IV > 0.02 or documented business justification
thresholdChecks.detail: SS1/23 P3.3 requires statistical justification for variable selection

thresholdChecks.title: Multicollinearity (VIF) Assessed
thresholdChecks.threshold: No feature with VIF > 10 retained without justification
thresholdChecks.detail: High collinearity reduces model stability and interpretability of individual feature effects

thresholdChecks.title: Highly Correlated Feature Pairs Addressed
thresholdChecks.threshold: No correlated pair > 0.9 retained without justification
thresholdChecks.detail: Highly correlated features introduce redundancy and reduce model stability

thresholdChecks.title: Bias and Fairness Evaluation Performed
thresholdChecks.observed: No bias or fairness evaluation in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: No material discriminatory bias identified or documented with mitigation plan
thresholdChecks.detail: SS1/23 P1.3 — bias in credit models has regulatory and reputational consequences

thresholdChecks.title: Variable Selection Methodology Documented
thresholdChecks.observed: No variable selection methodology in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: Selection method documented; consistent with industry practice
thresholdChecks.detail: SS11/13 §9.1 requires all rating system inputs to be fully documented

thresholdChecks.title: Transformation Assumptions Justified
thresholdChecks.threshold: Transformations improve model fit; assumptions documented
thresholdChecks.detail: Log transforms, binning choices must be statistically motivated

thresholdChecks.title: Model Operating Boundaries Defined
thresholdChecks.observed: No operating boundaries defined in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: Score range and input domain documented; extrapolation risks acknowledged
thresholdChecks.detail: Without defined boundaries the model may be misapplied

thresholdChecks.title: Hyperparameter Tuning Documented
thresholdChecks.observed: No hyperparameter tuning documentation in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: Tuning method reproducible; final parameters logged
thresholdChecks.detail: Undocumented tuning cannot be independently verified

thresholdChecks.title: Class Imbalance Treatment Documented
thresholdChecks.observed: No class imbalance treatment in MDD
thresholdChecks.threshold: SMOTE parameters or class weighting documented
thresholdChecks.detail: Imbalance treatment must be documented per SS1/23 P3.5

ragRules.flag: The MDD must clearly state the model's intended use, the portfolio it covers, and any constraints on its applicability.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a Model Purpose & Scope section stating: what decision the model supports, the portfolio it applies to, and any out-of-scope use cases.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must justify the choice of modelling technique with reference to the model's purpose, data characteristics, and regulatory requirements.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a Model Selection section documenting: why the chosen algorithm is appropriate, what alternatives were considered, and why they were rejected.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must provide evidence of testing the chosen model against at least one simpler or alternative model, including comparative performance metrics.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a Benchmarking section comparing the chosen model to at least one baseline (e.g. logistic regression), with AUC/Gini scores for each.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must explicitly document all material model assumptions and known limitations, including conditions under which the model may not perform as intended.
ragRules.suggestion: Add an Assumptions & Limitations section listing all material simplifying assumptions and conditions under which model performance may degrade.

ragRules.flag: For IFRS 9 models, the MDD must document the SICR criteria used, including quantitative triggers (e.g. PD increase thresholds) and qualitative backstops.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a SICR section defining the criteria used to identify significant increases in credit risk, including quantitative thresholds and qualitative indicators.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must document how the model's outputs can be explained to business users and regulators, including feature importance analysis.
ragRules.suggestion: Add an Explainability section covering: feature importance methodology (e.g. SHAP), how outputs are communicated to decision-makers, and any interpretability constraints.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must document model governance arrangements including version control, model owner, review frequency, and escalation process for material changes.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a Governance section covering: model owner, version history, planned review cycle, and the process for approving material model changes.

ragRules.flag: The MDD must document the rationale and objectives for using the model, clearly defining its scope of application before development begins.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a 'Model Definition and Business Objectives' section to the MDD.
ragRules.principle: Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026, Chapter – IV, Section 26(1)

ragRules.flag: The MDD must document the consideration of costs and benefits associated with the model, including risks, adverse outcomes, fairness, ethical considerations, and potential bias.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a 'Model Selection and Rationale' section to the MDD.
ragRules.principle: Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026, Chapter – IV, Section 26(2)

ragRules.flag: The MDD must demonstrate that the model design and methodology follow a structured process aligned with intended use, covering data preprocessing, assumption assessment, limitations, and performance evaluation.
ragRules.suggestion: Add a 'Model Design and Methodology' section to the MDD.
ragRules.principle: Guidance on Regulatory Principles for Model Risk Management, 2026, Chapter – IV, Section 27

regulatoryAlignment.remediation_summary: Address 1 high-severity finding(s) before approval. Document and remediate 8 warning(s) in the MDD or model controls.
